mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(age), 0), 2) AS avgAge, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(bmi), 0), 2) AS avgBmi, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(gestational_days), 0), 2) AS avgGestationalDays, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(raw_read_count), 0), 0) AS avgRawReadCount, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(mapping_ratio), 0), 4) AS avgMappingRatio, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(duplicate_read_ratio), 0), 4) AS avgDuplicateReadRatio, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(filtered_read_ratio), 0), 4) AS avgFilteredReadRatio, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(gc_content), 0), 4) AS avgGcContent, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(chr_y_concentration), 0), 4) AS avgYConcentration, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(chr_x_concentration), 0), 4) AS avgXConcentration, SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abnormalCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2) AS abnormalRate, SUM(CASE WHEN fetus_healthy = '是' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS healthyCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN fetus_healthy = '是' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2) AS healthyRate, SUM(CASE WHEN fetus_gender = '男胎' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS maleFetusCount, SUM(CASE WHEN fetus_gender = '女胎' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS femaleFetusCount FROM

SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(fetus_gender, ''), '未知') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM
GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(fetus_gender, ''), '未知') ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(fetus_healthy, ''), '未知') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM
GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(fetus_healthy, ''), '未知') ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN chromosome_aneuploidy IS NULL OR chromosome_aneuploidy = '' THEN '未提示异常' WHEN chromosome_aneuploidy IN ('无', '正常', '未见异常', '否', 'None', 'none', 'NA', 'N/A', '--', '-') THEN '未提示异常' ELSE chromosome_aneuploidy END AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM
GROUP BY CASE WHEN chromosome_aneuploidy IS NULL OR chromosome_aneuploidy = '' THEN '未提示异常' WHEN chromosome_aneuploidy IN ('无', '正常', '未见异常', '否', 'None', 'none', 'NA', 'N/A', '--', '-') THEN '未提示异常' ELSE chromosome_aneuploidy END ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT ageSegment, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(bmi), 0), 2) AS avgBmi, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(gestational_days), 0), 2) AS avgGestationalDays, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(chr_y_concentration), 0) * 100, 2) AS avgYConcentration, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(chr21_z_value), 0), 4) AS avgChr21ZValue, SUM(CASE WHEN isAbnormal = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abnormalCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN isAbnormal = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2) AS abnormalRate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN fetus_healthy = '是' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2) AS healthyRate FROM ( SELECT *, CASE WHEN age IS NULL THEN '未知' WHEN age < 25 THEN '<25岁' WHEN age BETWEEN 25 AND 29 THEN '25-29岁' WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 34 THEN '30-34岁' WHEN age BETWEEN 35 AND 39 THEN '35-39岁' ELSE '≥40岁' END AS ageSegment, CASE WHEN age IS NULL THEN 99 WHEN age < 25 THEN 1 WHEN age BETWEEN 25 AND 29 THEN 2 WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 34 THEN 3 WHEN age BETWEEN 35 AND 39 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS sortOrder, CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isAbnormal FROM
) t GROUP BY ageSegment, sortOrder ORDER BY sortOrder ASC

SELECT bmiSegment, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(age), 0), 2) AS avgAge, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(gestational_days), 0), 2) AS avgGestationalDays, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(chr_y_concentration), 0) * 100, 2) AS avgYConcentration, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(filtered_read_ratio), 0) * 100, 2) AS avgFilteredReadRatio, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(mapping_ratio), 0) * 100, 2) AS avgMappingRatio, SUM(CASE WHEN isAbnormal = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abnormalCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN isAbnormal = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2) AS abnormalRate, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN fetus_healthy = '是' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2) AS healthyRate FROM ( SELECT *, CASE WHEN bmi IS NULL THEN '未知' WHEN bmi < 18.5 THEN '<18.5偏低' WHEN bmi >= 18.5 AND bmi < 24 THEN '18.5-23.9正常' WHEN bmi >= 24 AND bmi < 28 THEN '24-27.9偏高' ELSE '≥28肥胖' END AS bmiSegment, CASE WHEN bmi IS NULL THEN 99 WHEN bmi < 18.5 THEN 1 WHEN bmi >= 18.5 AND bmi < 24 THEN 2 WHEN bmi >= 24 AND bmi < 28 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS sortOrder, CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isAbnormal FROM
) t GROUP BY bmiSegment, sortOrder ORDER BY sortOrder ASC

SELECT gestationalSegment, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(bmi), 0), 2) AS avgBmi, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(mapping_ratio), 0) * 100, 2) AS avgMappingRatio, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(duplicate_read_ratio), 0) * 100, 2) AS avgDuplicateReadRatio, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(filtered_read_ratio), 0) * 100, 2) AS avgFilteredReadRatio, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(gc_content), 0) * 100, 2) AS avgGcContent, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(chr_y_concentration), 0) * 100, 2) AS avgYConcentration, SUM(CASE WHEN isAbnormal = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abnormalCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN isAbnormal = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2) AS abnormalRate FROM ( SELECT *, CASE WHEN gestational_days IS NULL THEN '未知' WHEN gestational_days < 84 THEN '<12周' WHEN gestational_days BETWEEN 84 AND 97 THEN '12-13周' WHEN gestational_days BETWEEN 98 AND 111 THEN '14-15周' WHEN gestational_days BETWEEN 112 AND 125 THEN '16-17周' ELSE '≥18周' END AS gestationalSegment, CASE WHEN gestational_days IS NULL THEN 99 WHEN gestational_days < 84 THEN 1 WHEN gestational_days BETWEEN 84 AND 97 THEN 2 WHEN gestational_days BETWEEN 98 AND 111 THEN 3 WHEN gestational_days BETWEEN 112 AND 125 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS sortOrder, CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isAbnormal FROM
) t GROUP BY gestationalSegment, sortOrder ORDER BY sortOrder ASC

SELECT ageSegment, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(chr13_z_value), 0), 4) AS avgChr13ZValue, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(chr18_z_value), 0), 4) AS avgChr18ZValue, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(chr21_z_value), 0), 4) AS avgChr21ZValue, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(chr_x_z_value), 0), 4) AS avgChrXZValue, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(chr_y_z_value), 0), 4) AS avgChrYZValue FROM ( SELECT *, CASE WHEN age IS NULL THEN '未知' WHEN age < 25 THEN '<25岁' WHEN age BETWEEN 25 AND 29 THEN '25-29岁' WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 34 THEN '30-34岁' WHEN age BETWEEN 35 AND 39 THEN '35-39岁' ELSE '≥40岁' END AS ageSegment, CASE WHEN age IS NULL THEN 99 WHEN age < 25 THEN 1 WHEN age BETWEEN 25 AND 29 THEN 2 WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 34 THEN 3 WHEN age BETWEEN 35 AND 39 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS sortOrder FROM
) t GROUP BY ageSegment, sortOrder ORDER BY sortOrder ASC

SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(fetus_gender, ''), '未知') AS fetusGender, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(mapping_ratio), 0) * 100, 2) AS mappingScore, ROUND((1 - IFNULL(AVG(duplicate_read_ratio), 0)) * 100, 2) AS nonDuplicateScore, ROUND((1 - IFNULL(AVG(filtered_read_ratio), 0)) * 100, 2) AS cleanReadScore, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(gc_content), 0) * 100, 2) AS gcScore, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(chr_y_concentration), 0) * 100, 2) AS yConcentrationScore, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(chr_x_concentration), 0) * 100, 2) AS xConcentrationScore FROM
GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(fetus_gender, ''), '未知') ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC

SELECT id, age, bmi, gestational_days AS gestationalDays, IFNULL(NULLIF(fetus_gender, ''), '未知') AS fetusGender, IFNULL(NULLIF(fetus_healthy, ''), '未知') AS fetusHealthy, ROUND(IFNULL(chr_y_concentration, 0) * 100, 4) AS yConcentration, ROUND(IFNULL(chr_x_concentration, 0) * 100, 4) AS xConcentration, chr21_z_value AS chr21ZValue FROM ( SELECT * FROM
) t WHERE bmi IS NOT NULL AND chr_y_concentration IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(test_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(bmi), 0), 2) AS avgBmi, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(gestational_days), 0) / 7, 2) AS avgGestationalWeek, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN isAbnormal = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2) AS abnormalRate FROM ( SELECT *, CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isAbnormal FROM
) t WHERE test_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(test_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC
